using System;
using System.Numerics;
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;
using Bits = @BITS@;

namespace ChameLab.Crypto.Hardnested;

internal static class Hardnested@NAME@
{
    [MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)]
    private static Bits A(Bits a, Bits b, Bits c, Bits d) => ((a | b) ^ (a & d)) ^ (c & ((a ^ b) | d));
    [MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)]
    private static Bits B(Bits a, Bits b, Bits c, Bits d) => ((a & b) | c) ^ ((a ^ b) & (c | d));
    [MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)]
    private static Bits C(Bits a, Bits b, Bits c, Bits d, Bits e) =>
        (a | ((b | e) & (d ^ e))) ^ ((a ^ (b & d)) & ((c ^ d) | (b & e)));
    [MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)]
    private static Bits Filter(ReadOnlySpan<Bits> s) => C(A(s[38], s[36], s[34], s[32]),
        B(s[30], s[28], s[26], s[24]), B(s[22], s[20], s[18], s[16]),
        A(s[14], s[12], s[10], s[8]), B(s[6], s[4], s[2], s[0]));
    [MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)]
    private static Bits Feedback(ReadOnlySpan<Bits> s) => s[47] ^ s[42] ^ s[38] ^ s[37] ^ s[35] ^ s[33]
        ^ s[32] ^ s[30] ^ s[28] ^ s[23] ^ s[22] ^ s[20] ^ s[18] ^ s[12] ^ s[8] ^ s[6] ^ s[5] ^ s[4];

    internal static void Search(HardnestedSearch search, uint[] odd, uint[] even, int start, int end)
    {
        const int stateSize = 48;
        int lanes = @LANES@, width = 64 * lanes;
        Bits zero = @ZERO@, ones = @ONES@;
        int blocks = (even.Length + width - 1) / width;
        var sliced = new Bits[blocks * 24];
        Span<ulong> packed = stackalloc ulong[lanes];
        for (int block = 0; block < blocks; block++)
        {
            search.Cancellation.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
            for (int bit = 0; bit < 24; bit++)
            {
                packed.Clear();
                for (int i = 0; i < Math.Min(width, even.Length - block * width); i++)
                    packed[i >> 6] |= (ulong)((even[block * width + i] >> bit) & 1) << (i & 63);
                sliced[block * 24 + bit] = @LOAD@;
            }
        }
        Span<Bits> states = stackalloc Bits[72];
        Span<Bits> feedback = stackalloc Bits[8];
        Span<Bits> stream = stackalloc Bits[8];
        Span<Bits> parity = stackalloc Bits[8];
        Span<Bits> b2 = stackalloc Bits[16];
        Span<Bits> b3 = stackalloc Bits[8];
        for (int oi = start; oi < end; oi++)
        {
            search.Cancellation.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
            if (search.Stopped) return;
            for (int bit = 0; bit < 24; bit++) states[24 + bit * 2] = ((odd[oi] >> bit) & 1) != 0 ? ones : zero;
            stream[0] = Filter(states[24..]);
            for (int block = 0; block < blocks; block++)
            {
                if ((block & 63) == 0)
                {
                    search.Cancellation.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
                    if (search.Stopped) return;
                }
                for (int bit = 0; bit < 24; bit++) states[25 + bit * 2] = sliced[block * 24 + bit];
                feedback[0] = Feedback(states[24..]);
                parity[0] = zero;
                b2[0] = B(states[46], states[44], states[42], states[40]);
                b3[0] = B(states[30], states[28], states[26], states[24]);
                Bits results = ones;
                for (int test = 0; test < search.Nonces.Length; test++)
                {
                    int common = search.CommonBits[test];
                    int nextCommon = test + 1 < search.Nonces.Length ? search.CommonBits[test + 1] : 0;
                    Bits fb = feedback[common], ks = stream[common], par = parity[common];
                    int position = 24 - common;
                    uint nonce = search.Nonces[test];
                    byte expectedParity = search.Parities[test];
                    for (int bit = common; bit < 24; bit++)
                    {
                        int shift = 16 - (bit / 8) * 8 + (bit & 7);
                        Bits plain = ks ^ (((nonce >> shift) & 1) != 0 ? ones : zero);
                        par ^= plain;
                        states[--position] = fb ^ plain;
                        var s = states.Slice(position, stateSize);
                        Bits a1 = A(s[38], s[36], s[34], s[32]);
                        Bits a2 = A(s[14], s[12], s[10], s[8]);
                        Bits last = B(s[6], s[4], s[2], s[0]);
                        Bits middle, first;
                        if (bit < 7)
                        {
                            first = B(s[30], s[28], s[26], s[24]);
                            middle = B(s[22], s[20], s[18], s[16]);
                            b2[bit + 1] = middle; b3[bit + 1] = last;
                        }
                        else if (bit < 15)
                        {
                            first = b2[bit - 7];
                            middle = B(s[22], s[20], s[18], s[16]);
                            b2[bit + 1] = middle;
                        }
                        else if (bit < 23)
                        {
                            first = b2[bit - 7]; middle = b3[bit - 15];
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            first = B(s[30], s[28], s[26], s[24]);
                            middle = B(s[22], s[20], s[18], s[16]);
                        }
                        ks = C(a1, first, middle, a2, last);
                        if ((bit & 7) == 7)
                        {
                            Bits expected = ((expectedParity >> (2 - bit / 8)) & 1) != 0 ? ones : zero;
                            results &= ~(par ^ expected ^ ks);
                            if (results == zero) goto NextBlock;
                            par = zero;
                        }
                        if (bit != 23) fb = Feedback(s);
                        if (bit + 1 <= nextCommon)
                        {
                            feedback[bit + 1] = fb; stream[bit + 1] = ks; parity[bit + 1] = par;
                        }
                    }
                }
                for (int lane = 0; lane < lanes; lane++)
                {
                    ulong mask = @LANE@;
                    while (mask != 0)
                    {
                        int bit = BitOperations.TrailingZeroCount(mask);
                        int index = block * width + lane * 64 + bit;
                        if (index < even.Length && search.Verify(odd[oi], even[index])) return;
                        mask &= mask - 1;
                    }
                }
                NextBlock:;
            }
        }
    }
}
